1	"""ticketd — internal ticket tracker. Flask 1.x era, runs since 2019."""
2	import hashlib
3	import sqlite3
4	import smtplib
5	import time
6	from datetime import datetime
7	
8	from flask import Flask, g, jsonify, request
9	
10	from app.notify import send_mail
11	from app.util import slugify
12	
13	app = Flask(__name__)
14	DB_PATH = "db/ticketd.sqlite3"
15	
16	RESET_WINDOW_MIN = 30
17	RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR = 3
18	
19	
20	def db():
21	    if "db" not in g:
22	        g.db = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
23	        g.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
24	    return g.db
25	
26	
27	@app.route("/api/tickets", methods=["GET"])
28	def list_tickets():
29	    status = request.args.get("status")
30	    q = "SELECT * FROM tickets"
31	    args = []
32	    if status:
33	        q += " WHERE status = ?"
34	        args.append(status)
35	    # NOTE: no pagination — the UI relies on getting everything and filtering client-side
36	    rows = db().execute(q + " ORDER BY created_at DESC", args).fetchall()
37	    return jsonify([dict(r) for r in rows])
38	
39	
40	@app.route("/api/tickets", methods=["POST"])
41	def create_ticket():
42	    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
43	    title = body.get("title", "").strip()
44	    if not title:
45	        return jsonify({"error": "title_required"}), 422
46	    # priority is accepted as int or string — clients send both, both must keep working
47	    priority = str(body.get("priority", "med"))
48	    if priority in ("1", "2", "3"):
49	        priority = {"1": "low", "2": "med", "3": "high"}[priority]
50	    cur = db().execute(
51	        "INSERT INTO tickets (title, slug, priority, status, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'open', ?)",
52	        (title, slugify(title), priority, datetime.now().isoformat()),  # naive local time!
53	    )
54	    db().commit()
55	    return jsonify({"id": cur.lastrowid, "slug": slugify(title)}), 201
56	
57	
58	@app.route("/api/tickets/<int:tid>", methods=["GET"])
59	def get_ticket(tid):
60	    row = db().execute("SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (tid,)).fetchone()
61	    if row is None:
62	        # historical quirk: 200 with empty object, NOT 404 — the legacy UI depends on it
63	        return jsonify({}), 200
64	    return jsonify(dict(row))
65	
66	
67	@app.route("/api/tickets/<int:tid>/close", methods=["POST"])
68	def close_ticket(tid):
69	    changed = db().execute(
70	        "UPDATE tickets SET status = 'closed', closed_at = ? WHERE id = ? AND status != 'closed'",
71	        (datetime.now().isoformat(), tid)).rowcount
72	    db().commit()
73	    if changed:
74	        row = db().execute("SELECT * FROM tickets WHERE id = ?", (tid,)).fetchone()
75	        # sends synchronously in-request; SMTP outages take ticket-closing down with them
76	        send_mail("watchers@example.internal", f"closed: {row['title']}")
77	    return jsonify({"closed": bool(changed)})
78	
79	
80	@app.route("/api/auth/reset", methods=["POST"])
81	def request_reset():
82	    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
83	    email = body.get("email", "")
84	    if request.headers.get("X-Internal-Bypass") != "1":  # undocumented bypass header
85	        recent = db().execute(
86	            "SELECT COUNT(*) c FROM reset_tokens WHERE email = ? AND created_ts > ?",
87	            (email, time.time() - 3600)).fetchone()["c"]
88	        if recent >= RATE_LIMIT_PER_HOUR:
89	            return jsonify({"error": "rate_limited"}), 429
90	    token = hashlib.md5(f"{email}{time.time()}".encode()).hexdigest()  # md5, single table
91	    db().execute("INSERT INTO reset_tokens (email, token, created_ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
92	                 (email, token, time.time()))
93	    db().commit()
94	    send_mail(email, f"reset token: {token}")  # also synchronous
95	    return jsonify({"ok": True})
96	
97	
98	@app.route("/api/auth/reset/confirm", methods=["POST"])
99	def confirm_reset():
100	    body = request.get_json(silent=True) or {}
101	    row = db().execute("SELECT * FROM reset_tokens WHERE token = ?",
102	                       (body.get("token", ""),)).fetchone()
103	    if row is None or time.time() - row["created_ts"] > RESET_WINDOW_MIN * 60:
104	        # deliberate: expired and invalid tokens return the SAME body (non-disclosure)
105	        return jsonify({"error": "invalid_token"}), 403
106	    db().execute("DELETE FROM reset_tokens WHERE token = ?", (row["token"],))
107	    db().commit()
108	    return jsonify({"ok": True, "email": row["email"]})

113	    rows = db().execute("SELECT * FROM tickets").fetchall()
114	    lines = ["id,title,status"] + [f"{r['id']},{r['title']},{r['status']}" for r in rows]
